content.overview: The Preamble is the ideological key to the Constitution, declaring India a Sovereign Socialist Secular Democratic Republic committed to Justice, Liberty, Equality, and Fraternity. Held to be an integral part of the Constitution and basic structure in Kesavananda Bharati (1973).
